I'm being a bit weird and retrospective. I was unemployed/freelancing unsuccesfully for 3 years after uni. I took this job cause I had to - the idea was to have it for a short time, get back on my feet, back to art/games. But instead i found a career I really, really love doing

Pretty much everything I'd told myself about working in an office was wrong. I made new friends, grew so much, learned so much. Yes there were issues - there's a reason I'm leaving. I took a job because I was on the brink of economic ruin, and it led to a new career and skillset.

I think just being able to paint because i loved it, painting whatever i felt like not constantly chasing portfolio requirements and every piece having to be a piece that earned money just gave me comfort and space to grow. Also i could suddenly afford tutorials and resources.

Its just weird to me that this last ditch move that i took out of desperation, because i HAD to take a job, transformed my life in such a positive way. Helped me grow in all areas, led us to buy a house, and made me now live quite comfortably able to indulge in my hobbies.
